responsibility: This Modula-2 definition module exposes the top-level frontend/backend control hooks implemented in m2top.cc. It declares procedures for starting and ending the global compilation context and for setting GCC’s unit-at-a-time flag, acting as the Modula-2-side specification for those global control operations.
same_name_distinction: Modula-2 definition module for the m2top group: it specifies the top-level control hooks as FOR "C" procedures for Modula-2, unlike m2top.h's native declarations and m2top.cc's stub-heavy implementation.
